diagram_title: Budget-first schematic composition with occupancy ledger

activities.title: Inventory content geometry
activities.description: 清點頁面內容：對每個符號計算 pin-inclusive 真實 bbox（含四邊 pin 外伸與 label 伸展量），彙總為內容清單與總佔用需求

activities.title: Solve frame and budget
activities.description: 一步選框＋配額反解：以內容佔紙面 60–75% 為目標選定圖框，反解 scale/pitch；pitch-scan 候選在掃描期即以帳本可行性淘汰，無可行候選則 BUDGET_INFEASIBLE fail-loud

activities.title: Reserve-place components
activities.description: placement：符號 body＋pin 外伸逐一向 occupancy ledger 申請 reserve，成功才落位；衝突即報，不做事後 resolve-overlap

activities.title: Reserve-draw emit geometry
activities.description: emit：label/stub/電源符號/圖框邊界逐一 reserve→draw，與 A3 共用同一帳本實例；不再有位置凍結後塞不下的死結

activities.title: Assert acceptance gates
activities.description: 事後斷言閘：每頁 pitch／圖框／利用率≥40%／label 互疊=0／offpage=0 全部降為斷言；斷言失敗＝帳本實作 bug，不是調參訊號
